component: S/MIME closure variants and UI feedback

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 931 and 934 preserve MIME paths that may carry either display or draft data. In the accepted S/MIME UI-sink lookup, IsMimeDraftData selects nullptr instead of calling AsMimeStreamData on a valid draft closure. The display branch suppresses UI feedback for header=filter and header=attach. Do not make a debug assertion fire for a supported alternative type merely to reuse a display-only accessor. Background crypto processing is not automatically a UI transaction.
title: Choose a valid draft alternative before asserting a display closure
